yellow.role: Signature. Hero banners, primary CTAs, highlights. Flat only — never gradient.

ink.role: Dark surface; body type on light theme.

blue.role: Trust. Data visualisation, information states, links.

purple.role: Insight. AI, agents, moments of surprise. Use sparingly.

do: Flat colour only — no gradients on the yellow banner
One accent (blue OR purple) per viewport, never both
Yellow reserved for the single most important surface on a page
dont: No colours outside the four brand hues plus neutrals
No yellow as a background for body-length text
No transparency effects or overlays on hero banners
